themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, often by generating code snippets or identifying errors.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing the development, application, and comparison of AI tools specifically designed for research processes, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for quicker comprehension.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines user interactions, behavior, and perceptions related to AI chatbots, including their effectiveness and potential biases.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Covers platforms and ecosystems built to support or facilitate AI-driven research activities, including infrastructure and frameworks.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Details how AI is used in product development, from ideation and user research to feature prioritization and release planning.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare and evaluate different AI tools available for research, highlighting their strengths, weaknesses, and best use cases.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in collecting, analyzing, and deriving actionable insights from customer data to improve products and services.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses the effects of AI on employment, job roles, skills requirements, and the overall economy.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
